meta.wiki: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Kingsblood

summary: In the Searing Gorge, Master Smith Burninate needs more fiery flux after What the Flux?. He asks you for incendosaur scales, Kingsblood, and coal, and accepts all you can offer.

sections.title: Fiery Flux Wanted
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate has little time for talk. His fiery flux is running low, so he asks you for two incendosaur scales, four Kingsblood, and coal. He will take all you can offer.

faq.answer: Master Smith Burninate asks for the goods in the Searing Gorge and receives them in person.
Burninate wants two incendosaur scales, four Kingsblood, and coal.
What the Flux? came before this request, and Burninate gave it to you.

faq.q: Why does Burninate want these goods?
faq.answer: Burninate says the supply of fiery flux is dwindling and wants it replenished.
